scripts.build: bun run --filter @halloween/admin build && bun run --filter @halloween/renderer build && bun run --filter @halloween/desktop build
scripts.dist: bun run build && bun run --filter @halloween/desktop dist
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @halloween/renderer typecheck && bun run --filter @halloween/ui typecheck && bun run --filter @halloween/desktop typecheck && bun run --filter @halloween/server typecheck && bun run --filter @halloween/admin typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test packages
scripts.dist:mac: bun run build && bun run --filter @halloween/desktop dist:mac
scripts.dist:win: bun run build && bun run --filter @halloween/desktop dist:win
